title: The Alliance (Siege Map)
rules: Citadark Isle has four approaches and a dome. Each approach is Held by whoever the player's run has earned.
For every approach that is Held, one named ally fights one battle for the player somewhere in Phases 1 to 4.

districts.name: The Whirlpool Gate
districts.heldIf: Hoenn's titans both rest; or Johto's young Lugia went home; or Chobin is free
districts.ifLost: The Crossing has three battles, not two

districts.name: The Lava Flats
districts.heldIf: Paldea's Engine was pulled apart (five Starmobiles arrive, honking); or Kanto's Blaine walked with the player
districts.ifLost: Lava hazard in Phase 2 (1/16 HP every third turn to non-Fire Pokémon)

districts.name: The Sky Lift
districts.heldIf: Any one of: Lance (Johto), N with a dragon (Unova), Leon (Galar)
districts.ifLost: Phase 2 has one more wave

districts.name: The Cliff Stair
districts.heldIf: Any one of: Cynthia or Looker (Sinnoh), Nanu (Alola), Diantha (Kalos)
districts.ifLost: The Breather heals 35%

districts.name: The Dome
districts.heldIf: Never
districts.ifLost: See Phase 4

title: The Sealed City (Siege Map)
rules: Saffron has four gates and five districts. Each district is Held, Contested or Lost when the climax begins.
The player chooses a gate. A Held gate is a free entry. A Contested gate costs one battle. A Lost gate costs one battle and its effect.

districts.name: North Gate
districts.heldIf: The rival is in the Help variant
districts.ifLost: The rival's battle is added to Phase 1 instead of removed

districts.name: East Gate
districts.heldIf: Raid 3 Triumph (the ghosts) or rocket.x.wire (the police)
districts.ifLost: Reinforcements arrive one turn sooner in Phase 4

districts.name: South Gate
districts.heldIf: Raid 4 Success or better, or rocket.x.surge-down
districts.ifLost: Major Surge joins Phase 3 as a third duel

districts.name: West Gate
districts.heldIf: Raid 5 Success or better
districts.ifLost: Shinobi Koga poisons the Breather (heal 35% instead of 50%)

districts.name: The Center
districts.heldIf: Never; Oracle Sabrina holds it
districts.ifLost: See Phase 1

districts.name: Magnet Train Station
districts.heldIf: The Heir is an ally, or Lance was sent here
districts.ifLost: The signal reaches the border: world state stays 5 in the next region's opening

districts.name: Department Store
districts.heldIf: Raid 1 Success or better (no tail money)
districts.ifLost: Shops are closed for the Last Rest

districts.name: The Underground
districts.heldIf: rocket-return.x.director-known
districts.ifLost: Phase 1 has no shortcut

districts.name: Harbor Road
districts.heldIf: Ampharos was calmed, or Raid 5 Success or better
districts.ifLost: Two Black-Label Pokémon join Phase 2

districts.name: The Plaza
districts.heldIf: Raid 4 Triumph (a beast is standing in it)
districts.ifLost: The plaza battle in Phase 2 is a Double Battle

title: Sootopolis Divided (Siege Map)
rules: Sootopolis sits inside a crater. Aqua holds the west ledge, Magma the east.

districts.name: The Harbor Tunnel
districts.heldIf: Raid 2 Success or better, or Stern turned
districts.ifLost: Entry costs one underwater battle

districts.name: West Ledge
districts.heldIf: Tilt is +1 or more (Aqua is behind), or Amber was beaten
districts.ifLost: Aqua's pedestal in Phase 4 has one more defender

districts.name: East Ledge
districts.heldIf: Tilt is −1 or less (Magma is behind), or Blaise was beaten
districts.ifLost: Magma's pedestal in Phase 4 has one more defender

districts.name: The White Rock
districts.heldIf: Steven holds it, or the Keepers do
districts.ifLost: The Last Rest shop is closed

districts.name: The Cave Mouth
districts.heldIf: Never; both teams are fighting over it
districts.ifLost: See Phase 2

title: The Mountain Under Siege (Siege Map)
rules: Mt. Coronet has four approaches and one summit.

districts.name: Oreburgh Gate
districts.heldIf: Raid 1 Success or better, or Volkner turned
districts.ifLost: The Last Rest heals 80% (brownout)

districts.name: Hearthome Road
districts.heldIf: Looker is free and Raid 5 was not Failed
districts.ifLost: Entry costs one battle with Warden Pell

districts.name: Celestic Path
districts.heldIf: Cynthia is coming up the mountain (The Wall at Celestic)
districts.ifLost: Cynthia arrives one phase late

districts.name: Snowpoint Trail
districts.heldIf: Raid 4 Success or better (Buck holds it)
districts.ifLost: Hunter J's airship has a clear run: +1 battle in Phase 2

districts.name: The Summit
districts.heldIf: Never
districts.ifLost: See Phase 4

title: The Five Bridges (Siege Map)
rules: Unova is held together by five bridges. Ghetsis is closing them.

districts.name: Skyarrow
districts.heldIf: Snattle was beaten, or the debate was won
districts.ifLost: The Last Rest shop sells at +25%

districts.name: Driftveil Drawbridge
districts.heldIf: Raid 3 Success or better
districts.ifLost: Anthea and Concordia cannot reach the Breather (heal 35%)

districts.name: Tubeline
districts.heldIf: Raid 4 Success or better (Drayden)
districts.ifLost: Hail starts one tier thicker in Phase 4

districts.name: Village Bridge
districts.heldIf: Hugh is still searching (The Stolen One, any choice but the last)
districts.ifLost: Aldith's vans reach the Chasm: +1 battle in Phase 2

districts.name: Marvelous Bridge
districts.heldIf: Raid 5 Success or better (the faithful walked out across it)
districts.ifLost: The news of a king reaches the next region: its opening world state is +1

title: Kalos on Every Screen (Siege Map)
rules: Lysandre's announcement plays on every Holo Caster in the region at once. Each city either listens or looks away.

districts.name: Lumiose
districts.heldIf: Raid 1 Success or better (the lights are on), or Sycamore with Sina and Dexio
districts.ifLost: The Last Rest has no shop

districts.name: Laverre
districts.heldIf: Valerie turned
districts.ifLost: Grunts in the climax carry accessories (+1 Couture Pokémon each)

districts.name: Shalour
districts.heldIf: The player has Mega Evolved at least once this region
districts.ifLost: Mega Evolution takes a turn to trigger in Phase 2

districts.name: Anistar
districts.heldIf: Raid 5 Success or better
districts.ifLost: Phase 7 is certain

districts.name: Geosenge
districts.heldIf: Never
districts.ifLost: See Phase 1

districts.name: Melemele
districts.heldIf: The player rapped back, or waited for the bus
districts.ifLost: Skull's blockade in Phase 1 has one more boat

districts.name: Akala
districts.heldIf: Raid 4 Success or better (Olivia and Tapu Lele)
districts.ifLost: Thin Light is stronger: glimpses every 2 turns

districts.name: Ula'ula
districts.heldIf: Nanu was asked
districts.ifLost: Rent Money, if not returned, fights in Phase 2

districts.name: Poni
districts.heldIf: Dulse and Zossie were met, and the player was civil
districts.ifLost: No warning before Phase 7

districts.name: Aether Paradise
districts.heldIf: Never
districts.ifLost: See Phase 2

title: Five Stadiums (Siege Map)
rules: When the sky turns, Galar goes where it always goes: to the nearest stadium. Each one is a shelter if its crowd is calm, and a disaster if it is not.

districts.name: Motostoke
districts.heldIf: Raid 1 Success or better (the Plant is throttled)
districts.ifLost: A forced Dynamax on the pitch: +1 Pulse in Phase 4

districts.name: Hulbury
districts.heldIf: Raid 4 Success or better (Lighthouse is ferrying people)
districts.ifLost: Rail and sea are both shut: the Last Rest has no shop

districts.name: Hammerlocke
districts.heldIf: Peony is in Wyndon and Sonia has the permit
districts.ifLost: The Vault's records are taken: Rose's Doctrine triggers twice

districts.name: Spikemuth
districts.heldIf: Always. It has no Power Spot, and nothing there can be forced to Dynamax

districts.name: Wyndon
districts.heldIf: Raid 5 Success or better
districts.ifLost: Their Majesties have the pitch: Phase 7 is certain

title: The Five Bases (Siege Map)
rules: Each Base either trusts the player or does not. A Base that trusts the player keeps its own Starmobile out of Cipher's hands when the link is taken.

districts.name: Segin
districts.heldIf: Raid 1 Success or better
districts.ifLost: Its core in Phase 6 has an extra shield

districts.name: Schedar
districts.heldIf: Raid 2 Success or better, or the player stood next to Mela
districts.ifLost: Starfall Street is burning in Phase 2

districts.name: Navi
districts.heldIf: Raid 3 Success or better, or the player wears Atticus's badge
districts.ifLost: The leak reaches the Street: poison hazard in Phase 2

districts.name: Ruchbah
districts.heldIf: Raid 4 Success or better
districts.ifLost: Six cores, not five

districts.name: Caph
districts.heldIf: Kieran chose Star, or Arven is the squad's cook
districts.ifLost: The Applicant fights in Phase 2 with Overlooked
